description: Use it when the person describes the yachts they want: where, when, how many people, a size, a type or a budget. Pass each wish as its typed filter (a list is any of its values; every filter must hold), and from / to whenever they gave exact days. With dates every row is free for that stay and carries its price, list price, discount and when the source was checked (checkedAt); without dates each row has its from-price. priceMin / priceMax count the mandatory extras. Every row links to its page on this site, with a photo: send the person there. notApplied lists the wishes that could not narrow the search. When nothing matches exactly, the rows are the nearest match and nearest says what was widened: tell the person. Paged: total and cursor. For deals or last-minute offers call best_deals; for what a stay costs before any dates, price_range; once they name or pick one, get_yacht.
